message: Dependabot proposes bundler updates after 3 days (default-days: 3 in .github/dependabot.yml), but Bundler waits 1 week (cooldown: 7 in Gemfile); its pull requests bring in versions younger than Bundler accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make the Dependabot delay at least 1 week, or run depcurfew apply
